cases.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM tickets GROUP BY category
SELECT t.priority, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM tickets AS t WHERE t.category = 'payment' GROUP BY t.priority LIMIT 20
SELECT id FROM tickets; DELETE FROM tickets
SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM tickets)
SELECT id FROM tickets INTO OUTFILE 'blocked.txt'
SELECT id FROM tickets FOR UPDATE
SELECT tickets.id FROM tickets WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, tickets.created_at, tickets.resolved_at) > 24 LIMIT 20
SELECT tickets.id FROM tickets WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, tickets.created_at, tickets.resolved_at) > 1 LIMIT 20
SELECT tickets.id FROM tickets WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, DATE(tickets.created_at), tickets.resolved_at) > 1 LIMIT 20
SELECT tickets.id FROM tickets WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, tickets.created_at, 1) > 1 LIMIT 20
SELECT tickets.id FROM tickets WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, tickets.created_at, tickets.body_redacted) > 1 LIMIT 20
SELECT tickets.id FROM tickets JOIN ticket_events ON ticket_events.ticket_id = tickets.id WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, tickets.created_at, ticket_events.occurred_at) > 1 LIMIT 20
